clients.title: Client configuration
clients.description: Configure each client from saved relay cards.
clients.restoreDescription: Undo AgentHarbor's managed fields while preserving other settings. Reopen the client session afterwards.
clients.releaseDescription: AgentHarbor stops managing this client. The config file keeps its current contents and old values are not restored. You can configure it again from the current file afterwards.
clients.released: Released. The config file was not changed.

clients.modelPickerVersion: The /model lineup requires Claude Code 2.1.242 or later.
clients.limitsHint: Leave empty to follow the model catalog (recomputed on refresh); a filled value is yours and is never overwritten by catalog updates.
clients.claudeCodeHint: Choose a relay to configure several models at once.
clients.opencodeHint: Select relay cards to add their models.
clients.noProviders: Enable a provider with a compatible protocol first.
clients.localHint: Requests use AgentHarbor. Keep the app running.
clients.backupHint: Other fields are preserved and a backup is created. JSONC is normalized to JSON; the full original text is retained in the backup.
clients.restartHint: Reopen the client session to use the new configuration.

newapi.nativeAccessDesc: Connect Codex directly to the selected provider and its default Responses model.
newapi.nativeNoRouter: Native access · local router not required
newapi.nativeProtocolHint: Native access requires the selected model to use Responses. Change its protocol or select a Responses default model first; no model will be switched automatically.
newapi.nativeProviderHint: Enable a provider with an API key and a default Responses model before choosing native access.
newapi.nativeAuthHint: Connect directly with the provider’s API key. Official sign-in files are preserved, but Codex may not show your ChatGPT account. Choose local routing to use official and third-party models together with account display. The key stays in Codex’s local .env, never in auth.json or a config preview.
newapi.nativeNetworkHint: Native model, sign-in and account requests use Codex’s own network settings. The network choice on each provider card only controls AgentHarbor forwarding and connectivity tests. Restart Codex from AgentHarbor after changing the global proxy.
newapi.routerNetworkHint: Upstream protocol, access mode and network choice are independent. Provider cards control model forwarding; Codex sign-in and account requests use Codex’s own network settings.
newapi.nativeOnHint: Enabled: Codex connects directly to the selected Responses provider. AgentHarbor does not need to stay running for model requests.
newapi.restartConfirmDesc: Codex Desktop will be terminated and restarted to apply the current access, model, and network configuration. Ongoing desktop operations may be interrupted; Codex CLI sessions in terminals and IDEs will not be restarted.
newapi.title: Relay Inject
newapi.description: Configure provider models and choose how Codex connects to them.
newapi.smartRoutingDesc: List official models + relay models together in the Codex desktop app and the Codex extension, with free switching.
newapi.routingOnHint: Enabled: the menu includes official models and every enabled relay. Requests without a selected model use the first enabled relay.
newapi.routingOffHint: Disabled: Codex uses its previous configuration. Add a provider below, test connectivity and pick a default model before enabling.
newapi.accountlessTip: When on, Codex does not require an OpenAI account and only uses relay models.
newapi.accountlessHint: Off: use your real account ｜ On: no OpenAI account needed, relay models only
newapi.groupAliasDescription: All model groups under this site share the alias.
newapi.empty: No relays yet. Add a site, test connectivity, then inject it into Codex.
newapi.balanceNotQueried: Not queried yet; refresh to auto-detect
newapi.testSucceededBody: Sent hi through {{model}} and received a successful response.
newapi.testDialogDescription: Send a real streaming inference request and inspect headers, first-packet latency and response content.
newapi.testRequestHint: This request uses the “{{mode}}” network mode.
newapi.networkDirectShort: Bypass the proxy for this site
newapi.networkProxyHint: This relay now follows AgentHarbor's global proxy setting.
newapi.networkDirectHint: This relay now connects directly without a proxy.
newapi.networkUpdated: Network mode updated; test the connection again
newapi.deepSeekPeakTip: DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing: peak 9:00-12:00 / 14:00-18:00 (UTC+8); all other hours and whole weekends are off-peak at half price.
newapi.name: Name
newapi.userIdHint: Numeric user ID from a NewAPI profile; only needed for balance queries. Leave blank for Sub2API.
newapi.accessTokenHint: NewAPI or Sub2API account access token for balance queries. It is never used as the model API key.
newapi.apiKeyHint: Create an sk- key on the site's token page; used for calls and model listing.

newapi.emptyModelLibrary: Fetch models from the site or add a model ID manually.
newapi.modelLimitsColumnHint: Leave the limit empty to resolve it automatically; set provider/model for an exact catalog match; leave compression empty to inherit.
newapi.codexCatalogHint: Local routing calls selected models using each model’s protocol. Native access lists all selected, available Responses models from the current provider using their real upstream IDs. The round marker selects the default. Restart Codex after saving.
newapi.protocolHint: Choose a default for models without an override. Individual models can use Responses, Chat Completions or Anthropic Messages on the same provider. This does not change Codex access mode or the network route.
newapi.protocolMismatchModel: The catalog does not advertise this protocol; confirm the upstream endpoint supports it.

threads.routerAdoptionDescription: This one-time adoption keeps the original thread ID and history, creates a backup, and binds the thread to the unified Router. Finish active tasks first. Confirmation gracefully closes and reopens Codex without force-killing it. Afterwards, select official or relay models in the same thread without repeated repairs. If shutdown flushes new history, review and confirm a fresh preview.
threads.routerAdoptionSuccess: Thread adopted into the unified Router
threads.routerAdoptionSuccessDesc: The original thread ID and history were preserved and backed up. Continue the original thread with an official or relay model; no new thread is needed.
threads.routerAdoptionOpenFailed: Adoption succeeded, but Codex could not open

threads.recoveryCatalogSuccessDesc: The SQLite thread catalog was rebuilt from the frozen preview fields and the list was refreshed.

recoveryStatus.missingCatalog: Thread is missing from the SQLite catalog
recoveryStatus.schemaUnsupported: The SQLite catalog schema cannot be reconstructed safely
recoveryStatus.insufficientMetadata: The rollout lacks metadata required for safe catalog recovery
recoveryStatus.journalBlocked: Recovery coordination file needs manual review
recoveryStatus.unsupportedPlatform: Safe writes are not supported on this platform

recoveryReason.compatible: This thread already matches the active Codex provider and needs no repair.
recoveryReason.officialAccountUnverified: Continue with the official account that created this thread.
recoveryReason.providerMismatch: This thread uses a different provider from the active Codex configuration and can be updated.
recoveryReason.providerConflict: The SQLite catalog and rollout provider disagree. To avoid an unsafe rewrite, this version shows the conflict but does not allow applying it.
recoveryReason.missingCatalog: When the safety analysis passes, the SQLite catalog row can be rebuilt from the verified frozen metadata below. Platforms without safe write support show a preview only.
recoveryReason.schemaUnsupported: The threads table has incompatible keys, affinities, or required columns that cannot be derived safely, so the catalog will not be written.
recoveryReason.insufficientMetadata: The rollout does not contain verified values required by the current threads schema. Permission and sandbox values will not be guessed.
recoveryReason.missingRollout: The matching rollout file cannot be found. Provider metadata repair cannot restore missing conversation content.
recoveryReason.invalidRollout: The rollout has no matching session metadata. Changes are disabled to avoid damaging the thread.
recoveryReason.invalidTargetProvider: The active Codex configuration cannot be mapped to a safe persisted provider, so changes are disabled.
recoveryReason.journalBlocked: The recovery coordination file is corrupt, unreadable, or uses an unsupported version. Automatic recovery stopped so the journal and backup can be reviewed safely.
recoveryReason.recoveryPending: A previous recovery left a coordination state behind. Confirm to finish reconciling the remaining provider metadata.
recoveryReason.unsupportedPlatform: This platform supports preview only. Applying recovery safely requires Windows file locking, so no thread data will be written.

threads.recoveryCatalogReady: The metadata and schema satisfy the safety checks for catalog reconstruction.
threads.recoveryCatalogBlocked: The safety requirements are not met, so the SQLite catalog will not be written.
threads.recoveryCatalogFieldsDescription: Confirming inserts a complete threads row with these frozen values.
threads.recoveryCoordinationDescription: The app will not delete or rewrite an unverifiable recovery journal. Review the journal and backup files in the recovery directory.
threads.recoveryMappingErrors: Field mapping or thread relation blockers:
threads.emptyDesc: Conversations appear here once Codex writes session logs; or adjust your filters and search.
threads.noFilteredResultsDesc: No conversations match current keywords or filter criteria. Click button to clear search.

diagnostic.counterResets: {{count}} counter regressions counted as new segments; duplicates may exist. Not an exact bill.

diagnostic.undatedUsage: {{count}} usage records without valid dates excluded from the chart.
diagnostic.inheritedSessions: Contains {{count}} ancestor session metadata records. This view includes inherited history retained in the file, not only new usage in this thread.

common.toastErrorGenericDesc: Check your network and proxy status, then try again.

update.title: Update Available
update.installBlocked: AgentHarbor cannot install updates from the current location. Reopen it from the real installed app path and try again.
update.installBlockedReadOnlyLocation: AgentHarbor is currently running from a read-only location, so self-update cannot replace the app bundle. Move AgentHarbor to Applications or a real local folder, reopen it from that path, then try again.
update.installBlockedAppTranslocation: AgentHarbor is currently running from macOS App Translocation in a read-only mount, so self-update cannot write the app bundle. Move AgentHarbor to Applications or a real local folder, reopen it from that path, then try again.
update.installPromptDesc: AgentHarbor is currently running from a temporary macOS read-only location, so future updates will fail. Move AgentHarbor into Applications, then reopen it from the real installed app path.
